description: Factory repo. template/** is rendered into consumer projects (shipped); everything else is the factory's own tooling.

customManagers.description: `# renovate:` annotations above a *_VERSION key (lint.yml reuse, eas-update.yml eas-cli).
The two unannotated EAS_CLI_VERSION pins in the mobile release module, kept in step with eas-update.yml.
One-shot tools run with pnpm dlx (migration-safety.yml squawk-cli, store-metadata-push.yml eas-cli).
The consumer's packageManager pin lives in a .tmpl manifest, which the npm manager does not read.
eas.json build.base.pnpm must equal packageManager (tools/check-version-sync.mjs), so it moves in the same group.
eas.json build.base.node: the same Node major as the scaffold's node-version file.
Maestro CLI zip. The sha256 on the next line is checked by sha256sum -c and must be updated by hand.
gitleaks binary. GITLEAKS_SHA256 next to it must be updated by hand.

packageRules.description: Keep the 5-day npm cooldown. config:best-practices brings security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm, a packageRule setting 3 days, and packageRules beat the top-level value. Limited to version updates so pin and lockfile-maintenance keep the preset's exemptions.
FACTORY npm: root package.json, the root pnpm-workspace.yaml override and the root lockfile. Never ships.
prBodyNotes: **Factory lockfile change.** Every component this adds to `pnpm-lock.yaml` needs a reviewed row in `scripts/sbom-additions.json` (release `1.0.3`, a reason of 40+ characters), and a 1.0.2 row whose component moved retires, or `machinery-sbom-drift` stays red. `CI=true node scripts/check-sbom-drift.mjs` lists both. Push the rows before approving; after that, do not tick the rebase box.

packageRules.description: The owner's devDependencies group, widened to packageManager and the typescript override so they never split. Non-major only.
SHIPPED: everything under template/ is rendered into consumer projects.
prBodyNotes: **Shipped change.** If this touches a harness-owned file (a workflow, `biome.jsonc`), run `node scripts/generate-released-shas.mjs --current` and push `template/shas/`, or `machinery-released-shas` stays red. Catalog bumps are proven by `canary` and `bootstrap-linux`, which render and validate the scaffold.

packageRules.description: Every major waits for a Dependency Dashboard click.
Pre-1.0 packages: under semver a 0.x minor is a breaking release (@supabase/ssr ^0.10 to 0.12), so it waits for a click like a major, in its own group so the rest of the catalog still flows.
The Expo SDK / bundledNativeModules set. The native-deps gate (expo install --check) reds any drift between them, so they move as one reviewed set.
next minors move the App Router contract. Patches, which carry the security floor, still flow.
typescript: the root override and the catalog pin move together, typescript-eslint 8 supports <6.1, and 7.x crashes eslint-plugin-sonarjs.
Pin the Supabase CLI exactly, in its own PR. A CLI release moves the local database image and the gen-types output (1.0.2 CHANGELOG).
codeql-action is pinned to codeql-bundle-vX.Y.Z tags, which the default github-actions versioning rejects; without this it never updates.
Runtime versions in `with:` inputs are policy: node-version 22 is the tested floor, Java 17 is the Android toolchain.
eas.json build.base.node keeps the scaffold's Node major (check-version-sync).
sha256-verified binaries: Renovate cannot recompute the checksum.
prBodyNotes: **Checksum.** Update the sha256 that sits next to this version by hand; CI fails closed on it until you do.
